title: Dolphins Down Under
specs: Custom-built twin hull glass bottom catamarans with four large glass panels for underwater viewing
High success rate of wild dolphin sightings
Opportunity to see osprey, great blue herons, stingrays, sea turtles, and other marine life
Children 8 years and under must wear life jackets by US Coast Guard
Respectful dress code required; swimwear not permitted without cover-up; men must wear shirts at all times
Wheelchair accessibility very limited; gravel parking lot and stairs to dock and vessel
I understand infants must weigh at least 18 pounds due to United States Coast Guard regulations pertaining to infant life jackets.
Each vessel is equipped with four large glass panels the size of a large door so that you have a chance to view the dolphins as they swim beneath the boats.

The glass bottom dolphin tours last one and a half hours, and there is one marine restroom facility available, as well as a snack and beverage bar and fitted life vests for children and infants who weigh more than 18 pounds.
